author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer the canonical public API type definition over an internal/duplicate equivalent, unless a circular dependency forces the internal one.
fix_shape: collapse the duplicate internal definition and reference the canonical API type instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define the symbols and interfaces describing a single data shape together in one place rather than scattering them across files.
fix_shape: co-locate the related symbol/interface declarations in the module that owns the data shape.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove an abstraction that a model simplification has made obsolete rather than keeping it alongside the new, simpler model.
fix_shape: delete the now-unnecessary type/interface once its underlying distinction no longer exists.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Colocate related symbol/type definitions with the object model they belong to instead of splitting them into separate files.
fix_shape: move the split-out definitions back next to the model definition they describe.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When importing many symbols that would collide with local names, use a namespace import instead of renaming each one individually with a suffix.
fix_shape: replace `import { x as x$, y as y$ } from './mod'` with `import * as mod from './mod'` and reference `mod.x`.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a package's README up to date with the list of its exported public APIs.
fix_shape: add/update a section in the README enumerating the exported APIs.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Require a function's input type to already satisfy its invariants (e.g. an already-constructed, well-formed object) rather than accepting a weaker type and patching properties into the return type.
fix_shape: tighten the parameter type to the already-valid type and return the same type unchanged.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A generic API operating over a type hierarchy (e.g. Obj | Relation) should bound and default its type parameter over the full union, not just one member, unless intentionally restricted.
fix_shape: widen the generic bound/default to include every member of the hierarchy the API is meant to support.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a plain readonly property over a getter accessor for a value that involves no computation.
fix_shape: replace `get x(): T` with `readonly x: T` on the interface.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When declaring an interface member that mirrors an implementation's method, carry over its JSDoc rather than leaving the interface undocumented.
fix_shape: copy the JSDoc comment from the implementing class onto the interface declaration.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define a nominal `unique symbol` in exactly one place (the internal module) and re-export its value and type from the public API module, rather than redeclaring it.
fix_shape: declare the unique symbol once internally and re-export the same value/type from the API surface.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove an old/legacy type definition once a newer canonical one supersedes it, rather than keeping both around.
fix_shape: delete the legacy type and migrate its usages to the canonical replacement.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove an old/legacy type definition once a newer canonical one supersedes it, rather than keeping both around.
fix_shape: delete the legacy type and migrate its usages to the canonical replacement.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a type and the types it depends on defined within the same public API module rather than extending pieces defined in a separate internal module, so the public shape can be read in one place.
fix_shape: move or redefine the dependency type in the API module instead of importing/extending it from internal.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not derive public API types from a legacy internal-types module; keep API modules self-sufficient and migrate off internal types.
fix_shape: redefine the type directly in the API module and stop importing it from internal.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not extract a type into a separately named alias when it is used once and inlining it is just as clear.
fix_shape: inline the extracted type definition at its single use site.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not offer two different ways to pass the same piece of data into a function, such as a separate positional parameter and a symbol key on the props object; pick one mechanism.
fix_shape: drop the redundant parameter and standardize on the single existing mechanism (e.g. the symbol key on props).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer composing a type from small, well-named interfaces that are legible at the call site over substituting a single broader combined type that hides which pieces are actually required.
fix_shape: expand the combined type back into its explicit constituent interfaces.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a nominally-branded base type that TypeScript can discriminate from arbitrary objects instead of an unconstrained `Record<string, any>` alias, when the domain needs to distinguish its own objects from plain JS objects.
fix_shape: replace the loose Record<string, any> alias with the branded union type (e.g. Obj.Any | Relation.Any).

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not leave `test.only`/`describe.only` in committed code — it silently skips the rest of the suite.
fix_shape: remove the `.only` modifier so every test in the file runs again.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Use a semantic design-system token for styling (e.g. an error/status color) instead of a specific hardcoded color utility class.
fix_shape: mint or reuse a semantic token and reference it instead of the literal color class.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Only mark an API `@deprecated` when there is an actual migration path to a replacement; use a TODO instead when no replacement exists yet.
fix_shape: change the `@deprecated` tag to a TODO comment until a concrete replacement API exists.

author: richburdon
principle: Consistently annotate (or consistently omit) explicit return types across sibling functions in the same module, rather than mixing styles.
fix_shape: add or remove the explicit return-type annotation so it matches the sibling functions around it.

author: richburdon
principle: Order an object/interface's properties with identifying fields such as id and key listed first.
fix_shape: reorder the struct's fields so id/key come before the rest.

author: richburdon
principle: Order the values in a list, such as a hook's dependency array or a parameter list, by significance — most important or least likely to change first — rather than arbitrarily.
fix_shape: reorder the list entries by importance/stability.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not rename an existing public API member without a clear reason; gratuitous renames create unnecessary churn for consumers.
fix_shape: keep the established name, or state the concrete reason for the rename in the PR/comment.
